title: The Missing Mascot Head
briefing: The Nordy the Owl mascot head was reported missing from Cedar Pavilion equipment cage between 21:00 and 23:00 on the night before Founders Weekend at Northbridge State University (fictional). Cage lock was intact in the morning; interior inventory shows the head gone and the spare jersey rumpled. Four persons of interest were near Cedar Pavilion during the window. Public records only — verify statements against logs before you stamp.
